data.source_itinerary: Day 1: Panjim & Old Goa churches; Day 2: North Goa beaches (Baga, Calangute, Aguada); Day 3: South Goa (Colva, Palolem); Day 4: Dudhsagar Falls & spice plantation; Day 5: Leisure, river cruise, shopping.
warnings: A catalogue-based draft: ordering is not route-optimized. Confirm opening hours, transport, permits, and current prices.
Cost ranges are daily catalogue estimates multiplied by days; per-person assumptions and long-distance travel costs are not verified.
data.considerations: Very crowded and expensive in Christmas–New Year week; respect dress codes in churches and temples.
